content: {"like":["Values strong moral virtue in classic British dramas like *Midsomer Murders* and *Downton Abbey*","Prefers action films with tense endings and clear honor themes, exemplified by *Goldfinger*","Enjoys high-quality Blu‑ray picture and sound in period pieces","Appreciates iconic gadgets in 1960s Bond films","Loves classic, underrated action‑drama films with good character teaching"],"dislike":["Dislikes theatrical showmanship that distracts from musicianship in concert recordings","Finds 1970s spy films boring, lacking attractive female characters and menace","Rejects long, drawn‑out episodes in modern crime series, wants more action","Dislikes farcical, laughable Bond plots with specialized gadgets","Avoids films with monochromatic photography and overly serious tone"]}
